svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Make the sheet size a setting read from the project file:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ANSI B (the default) or ISO A3 (decision D3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Lay out frame, zone ticks, title block and revision table from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sheet size, so both sizes use the same code.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Take the footer organisation and website from the identity

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Keep the text-overlap check and run it on every sheet saved.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the project's model hands over named parts (joint 5). The

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: model and its STEP and STL exports belong to the project, not

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: render one sheet at each size; the overlap check reports

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nothing; the title block reads the second identity.
